name: Welcome to the Jungle

meta.next: Panther Mastery (Classic), Raptor Mastery (Classic), The Green Hills of Stranglethorn (Classic), Tiger Mastery (Classic)

summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Barnil Stonepot welcomes newcomers to the hunting camp and spots a seasoned wanderer. He offers to introduce you to Hemet Nesingwary, the expedition's leader.

sections.title: An Audience with the Master
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot greets newcomers at the camp in Stranglethorn Vale. He spots seasoned fighters and points out Hemet Nesingwary, an Alliance war hero and peerless tracker. Nesingwary keeps company with veterans who have proved themselves. Barnil thinks the old marksman may share his hunting wisdom with someone who has endured battle.

sections.title: The Trials of the Expedition
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary welcomes you and remarks how rare it is to meet someone of your calling in these wild lands. His expedition came to hunt a legendary, elusive jungle beast. He will include you in the chase once you earn his trust by hunting lesser quarry. Nesingwary oversees the raptor hunt. His comrades Ajeck and Sir Erlgadin teach hunters to pursue tigers and panthers.

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary is a celebrated Alliance war veteran and renowned big game hunter. He leads an expedition camp in Stranglethorn Vale's jungles.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Nesingwary?
aliases: who starts welcome to the jungle
faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot, at the jungle encampment, directs seasoned adventurers to greet Nesingwary after recognizing their combat experience.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Nesingwary?
faq.answer: After you speak with Nesingwary, several hunts open up: Raptor Mastery, Tiger Mastery, Panther Mastery and The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.

angles.text: As a hunter in Stranglethorn's jungles, you may find Hemet Nesingwary has hunting pointers to share.
As an Alliance veteran, you learn from Barnil Stonepot that Hemet Nesingwary is a renowned war hero who favors fellow veterans.
As a dwarf, you share a race with the camp's famed hunter, Hemet Nesingwary. Barnil Stonepot points him out as a master big game hunter.
